en: This is a vintage postcard showing a hand-colored photograph of a prominent building labeled 'Teatern' (theatre) in a central urban area, likely taken in the early 20th century. The view captures several other multi-story buildings and a tree-lined area, suggesting an important civic location. The text 'Sundsvall. Teatern & Godtemplarhuset.' is clearly printed at the top, indicating the picture is of Sundsvall's theatre and the Good Templars' House.
